tagline: Faceted counters: You can now facet a counter visualization to show one counter tile per dimension value.
what_it_does: Faceted counters: You can now facet a counter visualization to show one counter tile per dimension value. Legend cross filtering: Selecting an item in a visualization's legend now applies cross filtering. Dashboard task page selection and tabular attachments: Dashboard tasks in jobs can now optionally include dashboard page selection and tabular attachments.
why_it_matters: Reduces operational overhead and unlocks new capabilities for data teams on Databricks.
